title: SwiftUI Performance: Find Redraws in Xcode Instruments
summary: Antoine van der Lee walks through measuring SwiftUI update frequency, duration, and root causes, then explains how RocketTrace packages trace findings for a coding agent. An iOS team can record one focused interaction in Release configuration, review the evidence behind each proposed fix, and repeat the same interaction after editing.
takeaway: Give the agent measured redraw causes and costs, distinguish frequent cheap updates from expensive bodies, and re-record the same interaction to verify improvement.

media.alt: SwiftLee’s Instruments recording showing SwiftUI update lanes alongside hangs and hitches
